import unittest

from solution import decode_nonblank


class DecodeNonblankTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_utf8_lines_are_stripped_and_blank_lines_removed(self):
        payload = "  alpha  \r\n\t\r\n café \n beta\t".encode("utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(decode_nonblank(payload), ("alpha", "café", "beta"))

    def test_falls_back_in_encoding_order(self):
        payload = b" first\n\xffsecond \n"
        self.assertEqual(decode_nonblank(payload, ("utf-8", "latin-1")), ("first", "ÿsecond"))

    def test_empty_and_whitespace_only_content(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_nonblank(b""), ())
        self.assertEqual(decode_nonblank(b" \n\t\r\n"), ())

    def test_final_unicode_error_is_reraised(self):
        with self.assertRaises(UnicodeDecodeError) as caught:
            decode_nonblank(b"\xff", ("ascii", "utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.encoding, "utf-8")

    def test_malformed_payload_and_encoding_collection(self):
        cases = [
            ("text", ("utf-8",)),
            (bytearray(b"x"), ("utf-8",)),
            (b"x", ()),
            (b"x", []),
            (b"x", "utf-8"),
            (b"x", ("",)),
            (b"x", (1,)),
            (b"x", ("utf-8", "utf-8")),
            (b"x", ("definitely-not-an-encoding",)),
        ]
        for payload, encodings in cases:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload, encodings=encodings):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    decode_nonblank(payload, encodings)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
